opis: The evening CONCERT at NIGHT on the forest glade from the reference picture: a deep blue sky full of stars and a round moon, the string of paper lanterns over the little log stage glowing warm gold, fireflies in the air. On the stage the BEAVER plays FOUR water glasses standing in a row on a little table, from the fullest (on the left) to the emptiest (on the right), tapping them with a spoon, his eyes closed with joy; beside him the BUNNY beats a small drum; the OWL stands in front and conducts with one wing. In front of the owl THREE little fluffy grey OWLETS stand in a row from the smallest to the biggest, beaks open, singing. At the side of the stage a TOWER of four wooden blocks - a big red one at the bottom, a yellow, a green and the smallest blue one on top - with a glowing glass jar lantern on the very top. On the tree stumps in front small forest guests seen from behind (a hedgehog, a mole, a squirrel) listen happily. Warm, magical and joyful.
